title: Not worth it. Inaccurate farm locations and no real convenience
body: I honestly regret wasting my time downloading this app. The idea sounded promising. They claim to bring local farms together in one place and charge a $29.90 annual subscription, with a 7-day free trial. The reality is completely different. When you open the map, you can see farms near you, but when you tap on one to get the address, it doesn’t even show the street number. It only gives you the street name. If it’s a long road, you have no idea where the farm actually is. A much better idea would be to turn this into a real marketplace. Connect local farms with customers, let people order directly through the app, and handle the delivery process. That’s what people expect from an app in 2026. Convenience is the whole point. Instead, you’re paying for an app that gives you an incomplete address and expects you to drive around looking for the place yourself. That’s outdated and doesn’t fit the way people shop today. I canceled my free trial right away. This app is not worth the subscription, and I definitely don’t recommend it.

If the order reset to #1 closest it would be a lot more intuitive and easy to use. - My iPhone 17 Pro Max on iOS 26.6.0 overheats and slows down when using this app for 5 minutes. I was just looking at different options in the map view. If this was fixed somehow that would be great. - If there were tags for whether farmers use specific vaccines, or other things they use that alter natural food that would make a ginormous difference. - Add a Butter category.
